provider_scope: typed-owner source-backed DOCX provider baseline; direct comparison with the high-level filesystem facade is out of scope
timing_scope: Package::from_read_at_with_limits_and_cache_limits + document + extract_text + package/document drop; returned text remains live after the clock; text destruction, hashing, oracle comparison, counters, and diagnostics are outside
setup_scope: corpus construction, source hashing, file staging, FileSource::open, instrumented wrapper construction, range-adapter construction, and limits construction are outside the clock
allocation_scope: optional operation-scoped global-system-allocator region begins immediately before the operation clock and finishes immediately after it; normal binary runs report null and the allocator binary emits the existing Sample record

corpus.shape: 200 paragraphs + eight 2 MiB PNG-signature media members

provider.source_construction: all provider adapters are constructed outside the operation clock
provider.file_scope: FileSource is opened before each iteration and the staged file is recently written; this is a warm-cache/recent-file provider observation, not a filesystem-cold result
provider.read_counter_scope: logical ReadAt calls observed by the named wrapper; counters are not physical filesystem or network I/O observations

wrapper.scope: caller-visible CountingReadAt calls around the provider source

media_range_proof.scope: compressed ZIP data ranges for word/media members only; a zero overlap proves only that the observed logical wrapper did not request or return those ranges
